nom: Dermalogica Clear Start Clearing Defense Moisturizer SPF 30

avis.texte: For the most part, this doesn't break me out. I have dry/combo, sensitive acne-prone skin, and some days I'll have a few whiteheads by the end of the day. It has a noticeable sunscreen/lemon or citrus scent. It dries quickly, but unfortunately, it often pills. After a few hours, I often notice a sunscreen taste in my mouth.

Lightweight, good for oily and acne prone skin. Slightly noticeable sunscreen smell but doesn't leave a white cast like other sunscreen products. Not as runny as the regular moisturizer by this brand.

avis.titre: Works Great with Acne Topical Ointment
avis.texte: This sunscreen has been my go-to for AWHILE. This is the ONLY sunscreen Ive tried that works well with my acne medications and routine - particularly with Azelaic Acid. All other sunscreens Ive tried with this have made my skin feel disgustingly sticky and oily. This sunscreen is the only one which doesnt make me feel gross or sticky. Another plus, I use a generous amount daily but it lasts FOREVER. I only have to purchase 2-3x a year maybe. I have extremely sensitive skin and its lightweight and gentle enough to not irritate my skin. I like that it doesnt really mattify or suck the moisture out of my skin like some other sunscreens feel. Definitely recommend to those on topical acne meds - it's a game-changer.

avis.titre: Great oil free SPF moisturizer for oily faces!
avis.texte: I have super oily skin and decided to try this as I like a more matte finish but with a non drying feel. This hit the spot. It does feel more like a sunscreen due to the texture and smell, but it also gives a moisturized feeling after your am routine and doesn't feel drying. I don't often leave reviews, but as I am about to purchase my 3rd tube, I thought it was worthy!

I've been using this sunscreen for monyhs now. Im on my 4th bottle and I absolutely love it! I have extremely oily skin that's very sensitive. This product not only goes on like a dream and absorbs quickly(which is great for my inpatient rushes lol.) But it also helps mattify under primer and control my oily skin a bit. Now does it completely stop oil breakthroughs No! But lets be real there isn't a single matte or oil free product that will. It takes a routine and work if your skin is like mine. But now I'm being recommended to use physical(mineral) sunscreen due to my melasma. I'm struggling to find one that will work for my skin type and hating letting this one go! Highly recommend this product if you want a good matte, sheer, daily sunscreen.

I have been enjoying this! I have been using it for 2 months now. I'm always on the hunt for a good SPF/moisturizer duo just because I am trying not to add more steps to my skincare routine. Often times, at least with cheaper ones, they leave my face very shiny. Even after hours of wearing this one, I don't see my skin very greasy at all! It's worth a try, especially for this price point!
This is my daily SPF for face, ears, neck and chest, and it never causes breakouts. It's affordable and non-greasy too.
It goes on smooth and feels great. Unfortunately, the smell is so strong and unpleasant. I scrubbed my face twice after using and it's still awful.

I was advised to use this by my esthetician. I have been using thos for a while now and i really like it. I have oily skin and i like thst it has SPF in it. I need to use items with SPF already in it, or ill forget.
Love this! The perfect everyday sunscreen. I love the matte feature - no greasy feeling at all. My favorite dermalogica product!

After reading all the promises I thought this SPF would be perfect, but like other reviews mention this doesnt dry matte at all and I need to use a powder after applying. For the high price this should do what it says. Sounds like there was some sort of change in the formula that ruined it.
This was recommended by my esthetician. And it works well for me. I like that it has sun screen in it and it doesnt seem to make my face oily at all. It works for me.
It left my skin very oily and I bought it because it was supposed to be matte.

avis.titre: Try it I think you'll like it
avis.texte: I usually break out from sunscreen. Even the one my dermatologist prescribed! I went out on a limb to try this 2 in 1 sunscreen and it did not disappoint. Great mattifying and no white cast (I'm a brown skin gal) yet moisturizing. I took this on vacation and it withstood the very hot heat and sun. Two thumbs up for me.

avis.titre: One tube good, one not good
avis.texte: My previous tube was great. Mattified the skin. Absorbed quickly. It did not make my skin oily. This newest tube is not good. While it still absorbs quickly it does not mattify my skin. I am very oily in a couple of hours if not before. I must note that i do shake the tube before use so i dont think im missing anything.
I like this a lot and it is my best friend during the summer. However it has a strong smell. Doesn't look greasy ot clig my pores so i keep it.
I use this every day and love it. This cream prevents my skin from becoming shiny/oily during the day, and it doesn't clog my pores.
I used this as a cheaper alternative toy usual SPF but it was greasy and broke me out. If i dont shake it i can see the oil.

Bought this for daily protection as I found the active sunscreen was causing breakouts and left me looking oily. This is a perfect daily sunscreen for under makeup/ when you know you won't be out all day and require spf 50. Effective for living in Canada and UK where the UV is less intense.

I bought this sunscreen on accident because I thought it was a free gift and didn't check until I picked it up in store. However, I decided to use it because I needed a new sunscreen and surprisingly, this worked very well for me. I have extremely sensitive skin and it sits on top of my other skin care products very well. This is also the first sunscreen that hasn't irritated my skin or burned my eyes which I truly appreciate because every sunscreen I've worn in the past had an extremely painful reaction on my eyes. I plan on repurchasing.

Such a great product for spf coverage and matte look. Goes on smooth, not thick at all and doesn't leave any white marks. Base layer of spf protection you don't even know is there and makeup can go on over easily.

Purchased this a few months ago and I've worn it several times. Good product performs as expected. Sunblock without causing excess oily feel to my skin. My skin has had no negative reactions, no blocked pores etc. happy with this purchase.
I use this product for daily use. It is lightweight and keeps your face clear and oil free.

i'm so glad i found this sunscreen! beginning with the biggest pros for me- i've seen no new breakouts, doesn't pill, and feels like nothing on my skin. i really hate when i can feel an spf on my face but with this product my skin feels light and clean. pilling and clinging to dry patches is very annoying and i've noticed ZERO pilling/exaggerating of dry patches. the few cons i have are very nitpicky- fairly strong smell and isn't mattifying. the smell is almost floral but mostly is just a normal sunscreen smell, which isnt a huge deal to me but might be too much for those sensitive to fragrance. i also wouldn't consider this a mattifying products which i actually prefer. theres little to no added shine but again, not very mattifying. overall i'm so glad i finally found an spf that works on my skin!
Enjoying this SPF, the texture is moisturizing and does the job. Not the best for under makeup but using it alone is great!

I am in love with this sunscreen! The scent is light and bright, the matte finish keeps me from looking shiny, and my skin feels healthy and refreshed. I now have my teenage daughters using it as well, we're fans!

LOVE love LOVE! such a lightweight and everyday wear type of SPF ! there is not white cast back to it which is a total game changer and makes it look so amazing underneath your makeup or just laying natural on your face ! definitely worth the money !!
This product is great. It does not leave my skin feeling oily and the matte finish makes my skin appear move evenly toned.

Considering I have very oily skin, this didnt moisturize my skin at all. I had to use it as a straight up sunscreen over my regular moisturizer which defeated the purpose for me. It was defined mattifying to the point of drying.

This product is really easy to apply leaving my skin feeling not too greasy and ready for the little make up I wear after. I'm really happy with this purchase and I will continue with the automatic reordering. I never want to be without it! My skin looks great!
A sunscreen that's easy to apply and makes my active moist seem more hydrating. So far I haven't sweat it off in the crazy humidity during the summers.

I do my best to avoid sun exposure to my face, so I am always applying sunscreen. This works really well, it's not runny like some other suncreens for your face and I like the way it smells. I feel that it works really well and don't notice any redness or irritation eithet!
The coverage it provides makes my face feel like it has nothing on it
I didnt like this at all! It leaves my skin so oily. It also feels very heavy. The only pro about this is there is no white cast.
Love this product. Gluten free. No chemicals. Light and gives SPF protection.

I am a medium-toned Black woman and it leaves no white cast! It does feel a bit thick initially, but it absorbs into your skin and isnt oily, once you've fully rubbed it in. I've worn it under makeup, and have also worn it before going on a walk, and I love it! I would highly recommend it if you have acne-prone skin that's both sensitive and oily.
It doesn't feel oily at all! It doesn't have a sunscreen smell, it feels good, goes on easy, and absorbs very well. I really like it. And it's not a totally unreasonable price. :upside_down:
I like that this moisturizer provides sun protection but does not make my face shiny/greasy looking and it does not clog pores.

I bought this a couple of days ago and I was excited to use it for the first time this morning until I put it on the smell hit me. I'm bummed because other then the smell it seemed like a good option for a moisturizer.
My teenage daughter uses this product and loves the way it feels on her skin. I am also happy to know that she is getting great SPF coverage as well.
Smells great and goes on easy without leaving a white cast on your face. Definitely beats all of their other sunscreens if you're not looking for anything special with a great price point. Age 23
Great product. Feel good on your skin and protects from the sun well.

I've always hated wearing daily SPF but now pushing 40 I know I need to! This is amazing. It IS matte just as the name suggests and it's easy to apply makeup on top. It has a slight sunscreen smell but not terrible and doesn't run into my eyes and stingy. I've not experienced any breakouts from it. Super happy with this purchase!

I absolutely love this product. It provides great moisture without being oily on my combination skin. It is so light and it gives me a slight "glow", plus SPF benefits. I originally tried this product when my aesthetician recommended it after a facial and was so happy with it, I've purchased more and started using several other demalogica products. I've recommended it to my cousin who also loves it and has very different skin type than I do. Couldn't be happier!

This feels very overly drying even layered on top of the circular hydration serum and moisturizer. And feels slightly stinging even a few hours later. It's very very matte and strong smelling and unpleasant. It smells of thyme. Wanted to love this because of the ingredients and reviews and my skin type has all the concerns this claims to target. Alas, I continue my search for an SPF.
My teens love this as their to go moisturizer, without having me to nag them on sun protection!
I think this product actually moisturized me really well. When I had bad breakouts I would put this on and wouldn't clog my skin at all
I have finally found the every day face sunscreen my skin likes. It gives a nice natural glow but absorbs well. Makeup layers on top nicely.
I love the clearing defense. It keeps my skin clear and heals any blemishes right away.
I use this matte defense before a day at the beach it protects well & doesn't feel greasy.
This sunscreen works nicely on top of the hydrating serum. It has protected me from sunburning. I don't really care for the fragrance.

I have combination skin and this was horrible! I'm disappointed because it seemed to have good reviews. It did not sit well at all under my makeup, everything was already sliding off within the first two hours. It does smell good though and didn't burn my eyes but those are the only good things about it

I have SUPER oily skin and this stuff works great. I wear it every day underneath my makeup. If I need extra moisture I just use the lightweight moisturizer underneath (purple label, also part of the clear start line).

avis.titre: Like it but wanted to love it
avis.texte: It does the job and protects, but it is still a little heavier than I was hoping. Living in FL heat and humidity, I don't need anything to make me hotter! But no breakouts and it is keeping my dark spots from getting darker and new ones from forming so giving it 4 out of 5.

Dermalogica moisturizers are very good. It keeps my skin feeling good and soft. I want to try this moisturizer with SPF for break-out skin because my skin is very sensitive with different kinds of sunscreens.

I am using treatments for acne. This provides good protection from the Sun and does not make me break out. It is also fairly light, blends well and lasts a long time. doesn't run in my eyes and sting like a lot of other face sunscreens.

I bought this for both myself and my teenage daughter primarily for the sunscreen 30. It feels nice and light and goes on with no streaks or white. It does not clog my pores and it works well to keep my skin protected from harsh rays.
Light weight, feels mildly greasy but not bad. Smells like sunscreen.
I love this sunscreen. It doesn't leave an overly greasy finish and doesn't burn your eyes. Also doesn't break my face out like a lot of other sunscreens. Works great under makeup too!
Excellent product. It's a tremendous relief to wear sunblock without being concerned about it causing breakouts - game changer!!
I use this spf everyday. It is easy to use and light weight. It hydrates while it protects. This stuff is like the holy grail of spf.
It felt amazing on my skin it absorbs quickly. It did not leave a white cast which i was impressed i totally recomand if you have oily skin . It also smells amazing 10 out 10

avis.titre: Works great for extremely oily skin!
avis.texte: I will always be oily, I've accepted that lol but this sunscreen/moisturizer does not contribute to the oiliness! It works great and layers well under my makeup!
I got this thinking it was the same as the matifying moisturizer but with new packaging. It's not and I am a little disappointed. I much prefer the other.
My skin is very sensitive to the sun and this product gives me the protection I needed. It's very light and no smell T all.

This sunscreen offers the UV protection I need without causing breakouts as badly as other sunscreens. I still get breakouts if I wear it daily, but I can wear this on days with heavy sun exposure without worrying I'll have a major breakout the next day.
I have used many sunscreens and unfortunately the acne got worse, but this product is the best I have used because my face is much better
so matte all day everyday. easy to apply. starts creamy dries clear. will 100% buy again.
Great lotion for every day wear which includes sunscreen. Matte is helpful for controlling oil and even with the spf it doesn't leave any whiteness

The product is great at not causing breakouts, however, I looked at the ingredients and the sunscreen used is avobenzene. This is a cancer causing chemical. Please make a product like this without harmful chemicals and sunscreen.
This is one of my favorite moisturizers. It's not to heavy and doesn't leave a greasy feel. The sun protection is a bonus
its everyday sunscreen easy apply on not make my face oily after hours passed.
Everyday sunscreen easy apply not leave white cast. Wish they make the same with SPF 50!

I have acne prone/ oily and sensitive skin so i always struggle to find something that works for me but let me tell you I loveeeee this one. It absorbed into my skin and left it moisturized/ glowy but not oily at all. However, it does have a very light sunscreen smell but I really don't mind that because of how good it feels on my skin.
I've struggled to find a sunscreen I like that doesn't clog my poresâ€¦ this is it! It's light and not oily at all! Feels like a moisturizer, not heavy and smooth on my skin!
Dried my skin out and actually made me break out a bit. Pleasant scent. Good consistency. Just wan't for me. Wanted to love, but wound up returning.
My favorite SPF to use. I have very sensitive skin, and this does not irritate or cause it to break out. I use it everyday.

I really like the SPF 50 formula better. It is lighter and doesn't feel so much like a sun block. I mix it with the moisturizer. Next time I am just getting a bottle of that again. Living in Florida sun block is so important.

This is one of the best smelling SPFs on the market and it does a great job of providing moisture and protection without being too heavy. However, the added fragrance and Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane cause a lot of burning for my sensitive skin. Up to an hour after application I still feel burning and tingling that is very uncomfortable. I dreaded putting this product on my skin after the first couple of days, and couldn't wait to stop using it. I hate to have wasted money on a product that my skin doesn't agree with, but at least the smell is good hahaha.

avis.titre: For once I'm not left greasy
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin that reacts to most products, but for one my dry/oily skin does not react! I feel hydrated and smooth! I also use the pore cleanser before and together they have helped reduce my breakouts!

avis.titre: Not greasy and doesn't have a weird smell
avis.texte: I have tried so many different moisturizers with SPF. I was beginning to think I wouldn't find one that worked with my oily skin. This one doesn't leave your skin greasy or leave a white residue. Keeps my skin matte all day and doesn't have a weird smell. Highly recommend.
I love this product so much i bought it without really knowing if it would be perfect for my skin but oooh my goodness it's PERFECT SO LIGHT WEIGHT NON GREASEY !! 10/10
Loved it! Thicker formula that takes a bit to absorb, but worth it.

I've been using this moisturizer for 3 years now and it's my holy grail. I used to have really bad hormonal acne that occurred during the summer and ever since I've added this to my skin routine, I haven't had a bad breakout. I use this consistently and during the morning and night. Love this product!
I'll forever be a Dermalogica believer! This face wash changed the game. I have oily / combo skin depending on the season. This face wash cleanses enough to feel clean but doesn't dry my skin out.
Protection in minutes perfect skin factors smooth feel on skin
Great for my gym days doesn't sting my eyes and less breakouts
Didn't receive the product and never heard back from company for resolution.
Non greasy. Doesn't sting my eyes. Offers great protection with a nice consistancy no breakouts.

I've only used this a few times, but I'm really happy with it so far. My skin is a combination of dry and sensitive, and I tend to burn easily. This not only feels light on my skin, but it also doesn't aggravate my skin.
Love the consistency, very moisturizing non greasy/oily feeling
I love how it doesn't cause my sensitive skin to break out even when I use it before I run outside
I use this daily! One of my favorite companies and love that they have an affordable line.
